How I operate

“The whisperer and the glue”

The work that matters happens long before a pipeline entry or a business case exists. I plant ideas early on both sides of the table, earn the buy-in and the trust that make them credible, and build genuine momentum behind them — then orchestrate the teams who deliver and stay with it until it lands.

01 — START IT

Plant the seed

Ideas placed early with the people who can carry them — inside Microsoft and inside the customer — then worked patiently until there is real buy-in and enthusiasm behind them. By the time an opportunity is formally on the books, the trust and the appetite for it already exist.

02 — BUILD IT

Orchestrate the V-team

ATU kickoffs, specialist alignment and account planning across every solution area, plus partners and engineering — so one strategy reaches the customer, not five.

03 — LAND IT

Drive it to agreement

Representing Microsoft on the joint Executive Steering Committee — a weekly cadence with RBC procurement and technology leadership — working the room until we reach agreement in principle on contract structure and commercial mechanics.

Consistency
  • Stepped into the AE seat while the Account Executive was on parental leave, carrying the account’s commercial motion alongside my own.
  • Through four to six months and five different Azure specialists, I was the constant the customer dealt with — the strategy never reset.
